content.text: Replica lag stay under 2s with batch size 5k so far; continuing on the remaining regions.
The worker job history table lacks created_at indexes on several shards, so retention cleanup scans full partitions during peak hours.
Backfill the missing indexes online with a throttled migration that pauses when replica lag exceeds the agreed threshold.
Validate query plans for the cleanup job and the history browser after each shard completes.
